user.title: Nabu Flow
user.description: Set up Nabu Flow, the notification routing panel. After setup, open Nabu Flow from the sidebar to add your people, Discord channels and routes.

abort.already_configured: Nabu Flow is already set up.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send a notification through Nabu Flow's routing: Discord, phone pushes and kitchen announcements.

route.name: Route
route.description: A route saved in the Nabu Flow panel. Its settings are used unless this call overrides them.

who.name: Who
who.description: A person key, a list of person keys, or all.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel key from the Channels tab, like doors or garage.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Sets the card color and quiet-mode behavior. Critical also mirrors to the critical log channel.

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: Post to Discord. Turn off for a phone-only notification.

phone.name: Phone
phone.description: Phone push level. Auto sends a loud push only for critical severity.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Aware sends quiet pushes to people who are away. Home only skips them. Ignore treats everyone the same.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Speak the notification on the announce device when someone is home.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: Attach a snapshot from this camera to the Discord post.

link.name: Link
link.description: A URL the Discord card opens.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: Calls sharing a key are limited by the cooldown. Defaults to the route.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Seconds to ignore repeats of the same key. Overrides the route's cooldown.
